import hashlib,json
from time import perf_counter
from experiments.research.candidates.srgg.paper_parameters import PaperParams
from experiments.research.candidates.srgg.structured_geometry import master_operator
from experiments.research.candidates.srgg.paper_ring_schur import RingSchurPlan
p=PaperParams("PARAM-I")
seed=b"SRGG-paper-exact-ring-Schur-preflight-PARAM-I-v1"
data=hashlib.shake_256(seed).digest(2*p.rank*p.rank*p.digits*p.degree)
values=tuple((x&1)-((x>>1)&1) for x in data)
w=tuple(tuple(tuple(values[(i*p.rank*p.digits+j)*p.degree:(i*p.rank*p.digits+j+1)*p.degree]) for j in range(p.rank*p.digits)) for i in range(2*p.rank))
g=master_operator(degree=p.degree,rank=p.rank,digits=p.digits,base=p.base,witness=w,first_squared=p.master_first_squared,second_squared=p.master_second_squared,r_squared=p.r_squared)
t=perf_counter()
try:
    plan=RingSchurPlan(g)
    result={"status":"prepared","metadata":plan.public_metadata()}
except Exception as exc:
    result={"status":"rejected","exception_type":type(exc).__name__,"exception_message":str(exc)}
result["elapsed_seconds"]=perf_counter()-t
result["fixture"]={"profile":"PARAM-I","degree":p.degree,"rank":p.rank,"digits":p.digits,"kind":"public deterministic SHAKE256 CBD1 fixture; not a generated root or security sample","seed_hex":seed.hex(),"bytes_sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),"witness_redraws":0,"entropy_bytes":0}
print(json.dumps(result))
